title: deep_review_synthesis
description: Synthesis artifact for a gated Deep Review run: a human-/agent-authored roll-up of durable `deep_review.json` findings (schema_version 1.0) into a verdict, prioritized risks, confirmed-good checks, explicit gaps, and cross-finding contradictions. Validated by normalize_deep_review.py's `validate-synthesis` subcommand via _mini_jsonschema (keyword subset - no $ref/anyOf/pattern), which also cross-checks every `finding_id` reference against the gated deep_review.json `findings[]` array. The validator is read-only: it never rewrites this artifact.

produced_for_run_id.description: Must match the deep_review.json run this synthesis was produced from.

top_risks.description: Prioritized risks; each must cite the durable finding it comes from.

verified_ok.description: Checks confirmed correct. finding_id is optional -- some confirmations aren't tied to one specific finding (e.g. 'decoupling placement checked board-wide').

not_checked.description: Explicit gaps -- never a silent omission. finding_id is optional for the same reason as verified_ok.

contradictions.description: Pairs/groups of durable findings whose claims conflict; both/all sides must be cited.
